articles.title: Washington Spirit avert scheduling crisis, keep NWSL semi-final at Audi Field; Gotham venue TBD
articles.summary: Game will be played in Saturday noon broadcast window. Shift to Northwest Stadium was reportedly in play. Gotham location TBD amid ‘atrocious’ pitch conditions. The Washington Spirit will play their NWSL semi-final at Audi Field after the club reached a deal to avoid playing a playoff game at…
body: The club announced late Sunday night that they will play their semi-final against the Utah Royals on 14 November (Saturday) at noon.

Audi Field has been the NWSL team’s full-time home since 2023, and it has hosted raucous crowds for the team’s playoff runs, including Sunday’s 4-1 win over the Portland Thorns to advance to the semi-final.

A Division III college football game between the Coast Guard Academy and the Merchant Marine Academy was previously scheduled for that same afternoon at Audi Field. ESPN reported earlier this week that the NWSL had been preparing scenarios that would see the Spirit play their playoff game on Saturday at Northwest Stadium, a 64,000-seat venue in Landover, Maryland, roughly 10 miles north-east of downtown Washington where the team have never played a game in their 13-year existence, in the event that both the Spirit and top-seeded Gotham advanced in this weekend’s quarter-finals.

articles.title: Trump says he was ‘only kidding’ about making UFC’s Dana White next press secretary
articles.summary: President says it was ‘just a little fun’ to picture White, UFC boss and Trump’s friend, in briefing room with fighters. Donald Trump said on Sunday that he “was only kidding” when he announced a day earlier that he had offered the job of White House press secretary to Dana White, the chief…
body: Speaking to reporters on his way back the White House from his beach club in Florida, Trump explained the premise of his joke, that if the UFC boss, who is a devoted fan of the president, took over the briefing room, flanked by six fighters, reporters “wouldn’t mess around with him so much”.

“So I was kidding, but I think Dana likes the idea, and he is a very capable guy,” Trump added. “Of course, I was kidding. And you could see that because I put all of the great fighters as his assistants, that they’re all going to come with him … It was just a little fun.”

Earlier on Sunday, the president shared an animated AI cartoon made by one of his supporters on social media, which showed UFC fighters beating up journalists and one, Josh Hokit, repeating the racist remark about Michelle Obama he made during the UFC event at the White House on Trump’s birthday in June.

The president said that his mock announcement that White would become his spokesperson, in a social media post on Saturday, “was an example of something where I was kidding, and then people said, ‘You know, that’s actually a pretty good idea’”.

articles.title: Australia selectors make early call to axe Marnus Labuschagne from Test squad
articles.summary: Under-fire batter will not feature in upcoming New Zealand series. ‘Still possible’ he will be recalled for tours to India and England. Marnus Labuschagne has been dropped from Australia’s Test squad.
body: Australia’s next Test begins on 9 December in Perth, but Bailey and his panel have made an early call to put Labuschagne out of his misery. Bailey told reporters the out-of-form star wouldn’t be considered for the entire four-Test series against New Zealand.
However, the door remains open for a recall on ensuing tours to India and England.
“This gives him a little bit of space and clears up a bit of conjecture... and we’ll pick the rest of that squad at the end of round four of Sheffield Shield,” Bailey said.
“It’s still possible [he will be recalled after the trans-Tasman Test series], absolutely. He’s always been an incredible performer at first-class level. So I expect that’ll be the case.

articles.title: Kyle Larson joins Nascar’s all-time greats with third Cup title in six years
articles.summary: Larson becomes first repeat champion since 2010. Hendrick driver clinches title in opening stage. Ryan Blaney wins season finale at Homestead. Kyle Larson is now a three-time Nascar champion.
body: Larson clinched his third Cup Series title in six years early in Sunday’s 400-mile season finale at Homestead-Miami Speedway, becoming the first back-to-back champion since Jimmie Johnson in 2010. Johnson won five consecutive titles beginning in 2006.

The 34-year-old Larson also became the 11th driver in Nascar history to win three Cup titles, joining an exclusive club that includes seven-time champions Richard Petty, Dale Earnhardt and Johnson. Jeff Gordon won four titles, while Lee Petty, David Pearson, Cale Yarborough, Darrell Waltrip, Tony Stewart and Joey Logano each won three.

Ryan Blaney won the race for Team Penske, passing Tyler Reddick of 23XI Racing with just over a lap remaining as NBA legend Michael Jordan watched from pit road. Reddick finished second, followed by William Byron, Christopher Bell, Bubba Wallace and Denny Hamlin.

But the biggest celebration belonged to Larson, who finished 12th. He stopped near the start-finish line for a smoky burnout before exchanging high-fives and hugs with his team and children. He then climbed atop his No 5 Chevrolet with the championship flag and all three of his children to celebrate.

articles.title: Norris sparkles in Sao Paulo despite firework mishap
articles.summary: Apart from getting too close to a firework, Lando Norris was virtually impeccable during a Sao Paulo Grand Prix that challenged the drivers to their very limits.
body: Showing off on the podium after winning the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, Lando Norris made his first misstep of an afternoon that had challenged the Formula 1 drivers to their very limits.
Norris jumped off the top step, and tried to do his signature move, where he uncorks the champagne bottle by bashing it into the ground.
Except that, not for the first time, the force of his jump pushed things too far, and he smashed the bottle.
Then, holding up the shattered top to the crowd below, he stepped backwards and inadvertently put the side of his head into the sparkles blowing up from the fireworks on the front of the platform.

articles.title: 'Not many sports teams have done it' - Wolff 'proud' of Mercedes turnaround
articles.summary: Toto Wolff says he's "proud" of Mercedes' turnaround to win the 2026 Formula 1 Constructors' Championship and feels very few sports teams have bounced back so quickly.
body: Mercedes won their ninth constructors' title on Sunday at the Sao Paulo Grand Prix, five years after their last championship, which was their eighth in a row at the time.

Regulation changes in 2022 ended Mercedes' dominance as they struggled to get on top of the so-called ground effect cars, but they have won the first season of the new 2026 cars, and also wrapped up the Drivers' Championship earlier this month with Kimi Antonelli.
"The thing is when you are in these difficult moments, like we all are sometimes in our lives, it's not that easy to keep going," said Wolff.
"Looking back in retrospect, you're saying, 'we needed these tough moments in order to grow as people or to grow as an organisation'. But when you're down, that is quite difficult to feel.

articles.title: Conor McGregor Demands Max Holloway Trilogy for Final UFC Fight, Dismisses Lower-Caliber Callouts
articles.summary: Conor McGregor’s desire to run it back with Max Holloway for his final UFC fight appears stronger than ever. The Irishman finally returned to the Octagon at UFC 329 after more than 1,800 days away, but his comeback didn’t go as planned.
body: McGregor tore his ACL and meniscus before eventually losing to Max Holloway in just 69 seconds. He has since undergone knee surgery and is now facing another potential year-long layoff.
Despite the setback, McGregor remains determined to fight out the final bout of his current UFC contract. And if he gets his way, Holloway will be standing across the Octagon from him.

For those unaware, the Irishman underwent surgery in August and has indicated that he wants to return during International Fight Week in 2027. If that happens, it would reportedly be the final fight on his current UFC deal.
Speaking at the BKFC Glasgow press conference, McGregor once again made it clear that he wants a rematch with Holloway above all else.

articles.title: Hamilton says he overrode Ferrari pit call due to 'lack of information'
articles.summary: Lewis Hamilton says a lack of information led to him overriding Ferrari's call for him to come into the pits as rain fell during the closing stages of the Sao Paulo Grand Prix.
body: Hamilton was running in eighth at Interlagos when heavy rain began to fall with 10 laps to go. While the leaders had already passed the pit entry by the time the rain intensified, Mercedes brought in George Russell from fifth.

Ferrari instructed Hamilton to come in, but he decided to do the opposite to the car just in front of him at the time, Racing Bulls' Liam Lawson. Hamilton's team-mate Charles Leclerc, running just behind him, came into the pits.
The seven-time world champion spun on the next lap in the treacherous conditions, before pitting at the end of it to follow his rivals onto intermediates.

While there was little at stake, as Hamilton ultimately finished ninth rather than claiming what could have been seventh if he had got past Lawson, it was the latest example of imperfect execution from the British driver and his Italia team.

articles.title: Rams vs. Cardinals odds: Opening lines for Week 10 matchup
articles.summary: FanDuel has the Los Angeles Rams as 7.5 favorites over the Arizona Cardinals entering Week 10. Considering the Cardinals are the home team, that is a fairly massive spread in favor of L.A.
body: L.A.’s defense has been the star of the show for the Rams in 2026 more so than the offense. Throw in the possibility that Puka Nacua could miss week 10, and that 7.5 point spread seems even less likely for the Rams to cover.

It should be interesting and worth monitoring to see if Gardnew Minshew get another start for Arizona as they could want to see rookie Carson Beck at some point, but that may not be against Myles Garrett and the Rams.

Garrett had three sacks in Week 9, does he get another in Week 10? Will Aaron Donald get his first sack of the year in Arizona? Will Matthew Stafford throw more than one touchdown pass? Will Blake Corum out carry Kyren Williams? Does Trent McDuffie make his return for the Rams?
There’s plenty of variables to consider, so pay attention as that 7.5 line could move between now and Sunday.

articles.title: Women's TGL: Latest results, schedule as Hull, Woad feature
articles.summary: A look at the fixtures and full schedule for the inaugural women's TGL season, featuring Charley Hull and Lottie Woad, with every match exclusively live on Sky Sports.
body: The tech-infused golf league sees LPGA Tour stars feature in a unique team format, following on from the success of the men's competition, with all players mic'd up and every match being played at SoFi Center - a purpose-built indoor venue in Florida.
Five teams feature in the inaugural season, each having a five-team roster, with Atlanta Drive GC, Boston Common Golf, Los Angeles Golf Club, Motor City Golf Club and New York Golf Club all involved.
Teams play 15 holes of golf each match, divided into two sessions, with nine holes of triples - three against three playing alternate shots - and six holes of head-to-head singles golf.

Each team players four matches in the regular season, with the top four teams in the standings then progressing to the semi-finals. The best-of-three finals then take place on the week beginning December 21, all live on Sky Sports.
